objectives.description: Extend approve-classify.sh with component_head and recorded_digest (needed by --check-freshness)

deviations.reason: Phase 6's --check-freshness needs the component HEAD and each item's recorded digest, which Phase 5's classifier did not originally emit. Extended the output from a bare JSON array to {component_head, items: [...]} rather than reimplementing review-parsing inside approve-guard.sh. No Phase 5 consumer existed yet to break (Phase 6 is the first caller).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — approve-classify.sh output wrapped in {component_head, items} in Phase 6, since Phase 6 needs the component HEAD/digest to implement --check-freshness honestly without recomputing Lean digests)*

deviations.reason: approve.sh's own current_digest()/recorded_digest() logic lives inside approve.sh's private $work/spec scratch file and requires the Lean toolchain context approve.sh itself builds -- not reimplementable in a standalone guard script without duplicating approve.sh (explicitly out of scope). Implemented --check-freshness as a coarser, honest, cheap check: the git short-HEAD the review was generated at (captured verbatim, never recomputed) versus the CURRENT git short-HEAD of the repo the guard runs in. Documented in the script header as a backstop IN FRONT OF, not a replacement for, approve.sh --record's own fine-grained per-item digest re-check (which the Risk table already names as the authoritative backstop).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — coarse HEAD-based freshness check rather than a reimplemented Lean digest comparison, documented in approve-guard.sh's header)*
